properties.name: v-model
properties.description: Binding to v-model. If ur-segment-wrapper component used, v-model of this ur-segment-button is ignored and v-model of ur-segment-wrapper is used instead. Boolean and String type is only used in single segment-button use-case. Array type has to be set when using multiple select use-case.

properties.name: value
properties.description: If component is checked, v-model is set as this value.

properties.name: group
properties.description: When used with ur-segment-wrapper, you can separate it by specifying the group name if you want to apply validator only to a specific segment button rather than to all the segment buttons under the wrapper.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size you must enter one of three types: small, medium, or large.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The color type. You must enter one of these types: 'primary','point','normal', 'red', 'orange', and 'green'.

properties.name: group
properties.description: When used with ur-radio-wrapper, you can separate it by specifying the group name if you want to apply validate only to a specific radio button rather than to all the radio buttons located under the wrapper.

properties.name: solid
properties.description: Define the appearance of the child ur-segment-button in the solid-button style.

events.name: click
events.description: This event is occured when clicked.
